steps.text: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
I still lifted the blanket like I had that massive cast under it
Your brain hasn't caught up yet 😭
Apparently it was expecting the cast to stay forever
Don't say that, I was starting to believe it too
Did you sleep better without it?
Much better, until I got up
My leg still feels like it belongs to somebody else
Stiff?
Yeah, and a bit shaky when I first stand up
Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
There goes my afternoon
I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
Through the walls?
You usually tell on yourself eventually
You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away
That's a very specific accusation
That's me knowing my boyfriend ❤️
For the record, my big adventure so far was getting to the kitchen
Did you make it back alive?
Barely, the coffee was terrible
Your coffee always tastes like you hold a grudge against the beans
It wakes me up
So would a fire alarm, you don't drink those
You're very talkative for someone who hasn't left bed
Excuse you, I'm dressed
I've even packed my bag and found both shoes
Both? Big morning for us
Don't ruin my achievements 😭
Did you have breakfast too or was finding the shoes enough?
Toast and a banana
The toast was slightly more toasted than planned
Burnt
Crispy 😌
Was that before or after you insulted my coffee?
I can do two things badly at once, thank you
Now that sounds like the girl I know
The girl you know is also checking that you're actually going to take breaks today
I am
A bit of walking around at home, then the exercises they showed me yesterday
No heroic expedition
Good ❤️ I'd rather wait a little longer than see you hurt yourself again
I know
It's just nice not feeling stuck in the same place anymore
I bet
When you're more comfortable, we can go somewhere without you having to plan every single step
Somewhere with decent coffee?
And chairs, I'm not taking you hiking 😭
You really know how to spoil me
I was thinking coffee and a pastry, but keep talking and you can have water
I'll behave
There we go 😌
What's your day looking like?
Classes this morning, then work
I need to finish checking a spreadsheet this afternoon before anyone else uses it tomorrow
That sounds dangerously responsible
I'm trying not to think about it like that
I'm mostly looking forward to not carrying my university notes around with my work stuff
Not much longer now
I know ❤️ I'm counting down
Wait, before I leave
I actually managed to get dressed without creasing everything this time
Enjoy it while it lasts, my bag will probably destroy that shirt in ten minutes 😭
You look beautiful
You answered suspiciously fast
Didn't need much thinking
Okay, that was a good answer ❤️
Do I get the pastry back?
You were never losing the pastry
I was just going to make you ask nicely
Cruel woman
Your cruel woman has to leave now or she'll miss her bus 😌
Tell me how you're getting on when I text you at lunch
I will, good luck with the morning
Thank you handsome ❤️ Love you
Love you too
